greet.text: Oswin Tarle, factor for the River Compact in Weirholt. If it floats, it pays, and if it pays, I log it.

choices.text: What do the barges carry at the dark of the Wanderer?
I found your ledger in the culvert.

again.text: Back again? The Compact's hours are posted.

choices.text: What do the barges carry at the dark of the Wanderer?
I found your ledger in the culvert.

barges_lie.text: At the dark of the Wanderer? Grain, wool, the usual. Dark water is cheap water, that's all. Fewer tolls, fewer questions.

barges_slip.text: He looks at the door, then at you. "Some clients pay for discretion. Very well. They pay a great deal of it. That's all you'll get, and more than you should have."

barges_stonewall.text: "Then it hums. Grain settling. Good day."

ledger.text: He reads the first page and goes very still. "Two hundred gold, and you never saw it. The Compact remembers its friends. It remembers the other sort too."

bribed.text: He counts the coins out himself and drops the ledger in the stove. "A pleasure. The Heron sails at the dark, as always."

refused.text: "Then I have a barge to catch." He's out of the back door before you can stop him. By morning the counting house is shut, and the Heron is gone downriver.
